info.name: Unity
info.summary: Unified issue and ticket tracking across Jira, GitLab, Redmine and GitHub
info.description: Unity brings your issues from Jira, GitLab, Redmine and GitHub into a single, sortable, cached view inside Nextcloud. Search across all your trackers, read issue details and comments, add comments, and log time — using your own API tokens configured per user.
info.author: Jochen Roth
